scope: Reporting INI raw bytes, live masks, modified-entry Restore and nondeprecated core error constants under the pinned CLI profile
contract: ini_get(error_reporting) returns the complete stored bytes. ini_set converts scalar/null values, stores all bytes including NULs, parses the C-prefix and returns the old raw bytes after option callbacks.

The pinned OnUpdateErrorReporting calls signed64 strtol base10 then stores low32; whitespace/decimal suffix and signed64 saturation precede signed32 conversion. This is a pinned platform boundary, not portable atoi overflow behavior.

error_reporting returns the live signed32 mask; changed long setters store full64 decimal bytes. Setting the existing mask preserves raw bytes. Strict source calls reject strings with ?int; explicit Closure->__invoke parses weakly.

Nonfatal @ suppression marks the INI entry modified without changing raw bytes. Restore invokes the initial updater only for a modified entry. END_SILENCE may restore a mask while retaining handler-written raw bytes.

Exact scalar reporting options work without FILEINCLUDEPATH. Stringable options use the authenticated finite source/callback route; normalized argument order, late sampling and caller ARG restoration are preserved.
All15 nondeprecated E_* constants have exact case-sensitive values and existing namespace fallback/shadow behavior. E_STRICT remains an explicit required deprecated-constant producer obligation.
